description.narrative: The provision of debt financing for the reconstruction and widening of the remaining 15 km long road section of the Minsk outer (second) ring road i road section Sloboda i Papernya km 0.000 - km 14.770. Contribution to economic development and operational efficiency from improved road infrastructure and services. The Project will optimise the connectivity around the capital between important industrial centres and tourist destinations in Minsk oblast, including with the Minsk international airport, and will provide a better link between the M2 and M3 motorways; it will facilitate the flow of goods and people and will divert traffic (especially transit traffic) away from the Minsk city centre.
